One mutation across every surface, mirroring the doc form exactly. Read
`internal/cmd/docreviewers.go` and `store.SetDocReviewers`
(`internal/store/approvals.go`) first: the doc side is `lode doc reviewers
<ref>` to view and `lode doc set reviewers <actor…> <ref>` to write, and
the task side copies both.

- `internal/store/reviews.go`: `SetTaskReviewers(tx, now, taskID, actorID,
  reviewers []string, eventID)`: whole-list replace, every reviewer an
  existing actor, refused on a closed task; `taskReviewers(tx, taskID)`.
  Event `task.reviewers_set` with `{"reviewers": [...]}`.
- `internal/api/tasks.go`: `POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/reviewers`
  (WL-REQ-1323), `guardedBound(permTaskWrite)` in `routeGuards`, with its
  `routeDoc`; `model.TaskDetail` gains `Reviewers []string`
  (`json:"reviewers,omitempty"`), filled by the task detail read.
- `internal/cli/tasks.go`, `internal/cmd/task.go`: `lode task reviewers
  <id>` (view) and `reviewers` as a field of the existing `lode task set
  <field> <value…> <id>`; `cli.TaskDetailRender` shows the roster.

First store test: set `{a, b}`, read back in assignment order; set `{b}`,
`a` gone; unknown actor is `ErrInvalidInput`; abandoned task is
`ErrInvalidInput`.
